[[Image:Scourge Manta.jpg|150px]] | profession = Monk | icon = [[Image:Monk-icon-small.png]] | level = 22 (26) | campaign = Factions }} [[Scuttle Fish]] can be found roaming the surface of [[The Jade Sea]] in groups with [[Creeping Carp]] and [[Irukandji]]. There are two Scuttle Fish skins, most Scuttle Fish look like [[Blessed Manta]]s, however the Scuttle Fish in the southern part of [[Rhea's Crater]] have glowing lines on them like [[Scourge Manta]]s. ==Locations== *[[The Jade Sea]] **{{NPC location|Archipelagos}} **{{NPC location|Gyala Hatchery|explorable area}} **{{NPC location|Rhea's Crater}} **{{NPC location|Silent Surf}} ==Missions== *[[The Jade Sea]] **{{NPC location|Boreas Seabed}} ==Skills== 14 [[Smiting Prayers]] (19 Smiting Prayers in [[Hard mode]]) *{{skill icon|Balthazar's Aura}} *{{skill icon|Dwayna's Sorrow}} *{{skill icon|Healing Light}} ([[elite]]) *{{skill icon|Healing Touch}} ==Armor ratings== {{NPC statistics | prof = mo | blunt = 66 | piercing = 66 | slashing = 66 | cold = 66 | earth = 66 | fire = 66 | lightning = 66 }} ==Items dropped == *[[Black Pearl]] *[[Decaying Mass]] *[[Jellyfish Wand]] == Trivia == The name for this creature may be a portmanteau of the verb ''[[wiktionary:scuttle|scuttle]]'' and ''[[w:cuttlefish|cuttlefish]]'', a species of cephalopods.
